name: btx-skill-jev-judge
description: Hand a bounded judgment repeated over many items (label, triage, match, score, yes/no) to TypeSafe's Jev through the tested jev-judge CLI instead of reading every item into context or looping an LLM per item. Ships the jev-judge skill; the CLI (PyPI btx-skill-jev-judge, run through uvx) redacts secrets before sending, limits the request rate, retries rate limits, and has a pilot mode and a flat-question check.
